parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the access control policy.

parameters.name: AclType
parameters.description:
The ACL type. Valid values:

*   black: blacklist
*   white: whitelist

parameters.name: AddressIPVersion
parameters.description: The IP version. Valid values: **ipv4** and **ipv6**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi enable-instance-access-control --acl-id acl-bp11escro2et2tioscy52 --instance-id apigateway-cn-v6419k43xxxxx --acl-type black --address-ip-version ipv4 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi EnableInstanceAccessControl --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'apigateway-cn-v6419k43xxxxx' --AclId 'acl-bp11escro2et2tioscy52' --AddressIPVersion ipv4 --AclType black
